last_completed_step: Phase 11 Icons complete. icons.json authored at the plugin root: 3-colour Airtable palette (red #F82B60 = access/discovery, blue #2D7FF9 = schema, yellow #FCB400 = data), with shape encoding operation kind (hexagon=auth, rounded-square=live API call, cut-square=local JSON builder, octagon=preset), a per-subcategory background watermark encoding the resource, and the foreground glyph encoding the action. Yellow subcategories use a dark #181D1F glyph for contrast; JSON-builder subcategories use the light tint of their family colour. All 19 component icons (24x24) + the ribbon logo (16x16, red->yellow gradient) rendered via pr-icon-generator and wired into Properties/Resources.resx. Hit dogfood F5 (add_to_resources duplicated every Designer.cs property against the Phase 8/10 placeholders -> 60 CS0102 errors); fixed by deleting the older placeholder block. Rebuild: 0 errors, 24 warnings (all the expected CA1416 net7.0-Mac set, F4). Then, at the user's request, the canvas subcategories were merged 11 -> 7: each JSON-builder component now shares a subcategory with the live call it feeds (Table JSON->Table, Field JSON->Field, Record JSON->Record, Attachment JSON->Attachment). Touched PluginUtilities.cs (7 constants, renumbered 1-7, dropped the unused CategoryZZUtilities), 12 component files' SubCategory references, the Components/ folder tree (7 folders), icons.json (the 4 'X JSON' subcategory blocks became per-component background overrides on the 7 builder components), plugin-spec.json, todo.md and CLAUDE.md. Verified visual-neutral: all 20 rendered PNGs are byte-for-byte identical before and after. Rebuild: 0 errors, 24 expected CA1416 warnings. Icons then revised twice more at the user's direction. (a) Diagnosed a 'random border' the user spotted: background.icon defaults to filling the whole canvas, so the near-solid watermark silhouettes bleached every tile while the rounded corners kept the true gradient, reading as a dark rim. Proved it with an isolated two-icon probe config (watermark on/off). (b) Dropped the watermark layer entirely and cut the palette to red + blue only: red #F82B60->#B0113F now means 'writes to Airtable' (CreateTable, CreateField, UpdateField, CreateRecords, UpdateRecords, UploadAttachment), blue #2D7FF9->#1B4FA8 is everything else; shape still carries live-call vs local-builder. Yellow and the dark #181D1F foreground are gone, all glyphs are white. All 20 icons re-rendered and re-embedded into Resources.resx (verified: no F5 duplication this pass, and the decoded resx bitmaps match the new PNGs pixel-for-pixel). Rebuild: 0 errors, 24 expected CA1416 warnings. Preset shape changed octagon -> bubble at the user's request; both preset icons re-rendered, re-embedded, rebuild still 0 errors. Final glyph pass: GetBaseSchema mdi:file-tree -> mdi:sitemap-outline (the file-tree glyph read as an indistinct block cluster at 24px). A Presets glyph.fit override was tried and reverted — the bubble shape's authored glyph box is tighter than 0.62 of the canvas so the override made the presets larger, and 0.50 made them mushy; the shape-authored box renders best, so no glyph override is set. All three icons re-embedded; rebuild 0 errors.

Icon system: colour=domain (red access/discovery, blue schema, yellow data), shape=operation kind (hexagon/rounded-square/cut-square/bubble), bg watermark=resource, fg glyph=action. Presets are blue (both feed the Field / Field JSON family) rather than a fourth colour.

Colour families and every rendered icon are unchanged.

Palette cut to red + blue only at the user's request. Red = mutates Airtable (6 components), blue = reads, local builders and presets (13). Colour is a risk signal, not a domain one; shape (hexagon/rounded-square/cut-square/bubble) carries operation kind.

background.icon watermark layer removed from every icon and must not be reintroduced full-bleed: it defaults to filling the canvas, which desaturates the whole tile and leaves the untouched rounded corners looking like a border. Use an explicit small align.fit if a motif is ever wanted.
